test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He told / his senior, "I / will sung a song / at the party tonight."
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. will sung a song .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is in the segment "will sung a song." The verb "sung" is the past participle form and is incorrectly used here.
 
• When using the simple future tense, the correct structure is "will" followed by the base form of the verb ("sing" in this case).

Correct sentence: *He told his senior, "I will sing a song at the party tonight."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simple Future Tense Structure:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + will/shall + base verb.
 
• **Example:** She will call you tomorrow.
 
• **Usage:** Describes actions that will happen in the future.
